versions.changelog: Budget walls: use status 402 on OpenClaw (429 gets retried as a rate limit); venv PATH fallback named concretely
Ledger 0.8.1 routes upstreams automatically so the upstream step is now a footnote; allowlist tip taught at the approval moment; Docker address probe; approval-gate fallback
Fix Docker address resolution; add fallback guidance when exec approval misbehaves

Initial release of agentic-ledger.

- Tracks every model call from OpenClaw, including prompt, response, tokens, cost, latency, and errors, all locally on your machine.
- Enforces hard budget caps by refusing calls once limits are crossed (daily/session budgets configurable).
- Provides API endpoints and a local dashboard for spend, usage, error reports, and run/session browsing.
- Supports replaying previous runs on other (including local) models, with grading and cost comparison.
- No cloud storage, accounts, or telemetry—data stays local; credentials are never stored.
